Pos.doc: An immutable position; block positions have integer coordinates.

offset.doc: Returns a new position moved by the given amounts.

toString.doc: Returns the position as text, for example `1, 64, -3`.

World.doc: One loaded dimension of the server.

time.doc: The dimension's game time in ticks.

getBlock.doc: Returns the block state at a position as `namespace:id[property=value,...]`.

setBlock.doc: Places a block state written as `namespace:id[property=value,...]`; returns `false` when the state does not parse or the block was not placed.

params.name: id
params.doc: The particle type id, for example `minecraft:flame`.

params.name: options
params.type: { count?: number; spread?: number; speed?: number }
params.doc: How many particles, how far they spread in blocks and how fast they move.

spawnParticle.doc: Spawns particles of a simple particle type at a position.

params.name: id
params.doc: The sound event id, for example `minecraft:block.note_block.bell`.

params.name: options
params.doc: The volume and pitch, 1 by default.

playSound.doc: Plays a sound event at a position for nearby players. The id can be a vanilla sound event or a project sound key (for example `mymod:block.chime`) once the project declares it in `sounds.json`.

params.name: command
params.doc: The command without a leading slash.

params.name: at
params.doc: Where the command runs: `~ ~ ~` is this position. Without it, the command runs at the world spawn point.

runCommand.doc: Runs a command as the server with permission level 2 and no output; returns the command's result count. Without `at` it runs at the world spawn point with no `@s`; pass `at` for position-relative commands, or use `Entity.runCommand` to run as an entity.

params.name: at
params.doc: Where the function runs: `~ ~ ~` is this position. Without it, the function runs at the world spawn point.

runFunction.doc: Runs a data pack function as the server; returns `false` when the function does not exist. Without `at` it runs at the world spawn point with no `@s`; pass `at` for position-relative functions, or use `Entity.runFunction` to run as an entity.

params.name: id
params.doc: The entity type id, for example `minecraft:zombie`.

spawnEntity.doc: Spawns an entity of a type at a position; returns `undefined` when it could not be spawned.

entitiesNear.doc: Returns the living entities within a radius of a position.

params.name: direction
params.doc: The direction as a vector, for example an entity's `look`; its length does not matter.

params.name: maxDistance
params.doc: How far the ray goes in blocks, at most 128 (more is a `RangeError`).

raycast.doc:
Casts a ray and returns the first block or entity it hits, or `undefined` when it hits nothing in range; for example `world.raycast(player.pos.offset(0, 1.6, 0), player.look, 20)`.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

Entity.doc: A living entity, wrapped for scripts; check `isAlive` before using one held across ticks.

type.doc: The entity type id, for example `minecraft:zombie`.

world.doc: The world the entity is in.

health.doc: The current health in half hearts.

maxHealth.doc: The maximum health in half hearts.

isAlive.doc: Whether the entity is still alive and loaded.

isPlayer.doc: Whether the entity is a player.

name.doc: The entity's display name as plain text.

velocity.doc: The entity's motion in blocks per tick (x, y, z).

look.doc: The direction the entity looks, as a vector of length 1.

data.doc: Data saved on this entity for the script's namespace, at most 16 KiB per namespace; a player keeps it on respawn.

setVelocity.doc: Replaces the motion, so the game moves the entity smoothly, as a slime block or a wind charge does; each part is limited to 10. Players are pushed too.

addVelocity.doc: Adds to the motion, for example `entity.addVelocity(0, 1, 0)` for a jump; each part is limited to 10.

overloads.doc: Deals generic damage to the entity.

params.name: options
params.type: { type?: string; attacker?: Entity; direct?: Entity }
params.doc: The damage type id (for example `minecraft:magic`; `minecraft:generic` by default), the entity responsible and the entity that hit (a projectile, for example).

overloads.doc:
Deals damage of a type, from an attacker, to the entity, for example `target.damage(4, { type: "minecraft:player_attack", attacker: player })`; an unknown damage type is a script error.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

damage.doc: Deals generic damage to the entity.

params.name: amount
params.doc: The health to add in half hearts.

heal.doc: Heals the entity, up to its maximum health.

overloads.doc: Moves the entity to a position in its current world.

params.name: options
params.type: { dimension?: string; yaw?: number; pitch?: number }
params.doc: The dimension id to move to (the current one by default) and the facing in degrees (unchanged by default).

overloads.doc:
Moves the entity to a position, in another dimension or facing another way, for example `player.teleport(pos, { dimension: "minecraft:the_nether" })`; the wrapper stays valid after the move.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

teleport.doc: Moves the entity to a position in its current world.

addEffect.doc: Gives the entity a mob effect.

params.name: id
params.doc: The effect id, for example `minecraft:speed` or one of your own.

hasEffect.doc: Returns whether the entity currently has the mob effect.

params.name: id
params.doc: The effect id, for example `minecraft:speed` or one of your own.

effectLevel.doc: Returns the level of the mob effect (the amplifier plus 1), or 0 when the entity does not have it.

params.name: id
params.doc: The effect id, for example `minecraft:speed` or one of your own.

removeEffect.doc: Removes the mob effect; returns `true` when the entity had it.

params.name: controller
params.doc: The animation controller, the entity's main one by default.

playAnimation.doc: Triggers a GeckoLib animation on an MSM entity; does nothing on other entities.

params.name: command
params.doc: The command without a leading slash.

runCommand.doc: Runs a command as and at this entity (`@s` is the entity, `~ ~ ~` is its position, in its facing) with permission level 2 and no output; returns the command's result count, or 0 when the entity is not in a server level.

runFunction.doc: Runs a data pack function as and at this entity (`@s` is the entity); returns `false` when the function does not exist or the entity is not in a server level.

asPlayer.doc: Returns this entity as a player, or `undefined` when it is not one.

equipment.doc:
Returns a copy of the stack in an equipment slot, or `undefined` when it is empty; for example `entity.equipment("head")`.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

params.name: item
params.doc: The new stack; `undefined` empties the slot.

setEquipment.doc:
Replaces the stack in an equipment slot, for example `zombie.setEquipment("mainhand", "minecraft:iron_sword")`.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

params.name: maxDistance
params.doc: How far the ray goes in blocks, at most 128 (more is a `RangeError`).

params.name: options
params.doc: What the ray stops at; it always passes through this entity.

raycast.doc:
Casts a ray from the entity's eyes along its look and returns the first block or entity it hits, or `undefined`; for example `player.raycast(5)?.block?.id`.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

isCreative.doc: Whether the player is in creative mode.

heldItem.doc: The item id in the player's main hand, or `undefined` when it is empty.

params.name: item
params.doc: The item id, for example `minecraft:diamond`, or since runtime 1.5.0 an item with components, `{ id, count?, components? }`.

params.name: count
params.doc: How many; the item's own `count`, or 1, by default.

give.doc: Gives the player items; what does not fit in the inventory is dropped at their feet.

hasItem.doc: Returns whether the player's inventory holds at least one of an item.

sendMessage.doc: Sends a chat message to the player only.

inventory.doc:
The player's inventory, for example `player.inventory.count("minecraft:diamond")`.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

xpLevel.doc:
The player's experience level.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

xpPoints.doc:
The total experience points the player has collected.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

food.doc:
The food level, 0 to 20.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

saturation.doc:
The saturation level, 0 up to the food level.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

gameMode.doc:
The player's game mode, for example `"survival"`.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

params.name: points
params.doc: The points to add; a negative number takes points away.

addXp.doc:
Gives the player experience points, for example `player.addXp(10)`; levels go up as the points fill them.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

params.name: levels
params.doc: The levels to add; a negative number takes levels away.

addXpLevels.doc:
Gives the player experience levels, for example `player.addXpLevels(1)`.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

setXpLevels.doc:
Sets the player's experience level, for example `player.setXpLevels(30)`.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

params.name: saturation
params.doc: The saturation, unchanged by default; it is never more than the food level.

setFood.doc:
Sets the player's food level and saturation, for example `player.setFood(20, 5)`.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

setGameMode.doc:
Changes the player's game mode, for example `player.setGameMode("adventure")`; returns `false` when the player was already in it.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

params.name: options
params.type: { subtitle?: string; fadeIn?: number; stay?: number; fadeOut?: number }
params.doc: A subtitle and the fade in, stay and fade out times in ticks (10, 70 and 20 by default).

showTitle.doc:
Shows a title in the middle of the player's screen, for example `player.showTitle("Wave 3", { subtitle: "Get ready" })`.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

showActionBar.doc:
Shows text above the player's hotbar for a few seconds, for example `player.showActionBar("Mana: 7")`.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

clearTitle.doc:
Removes the title and subtitle from the player's screen.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

BlockRef.doc: A block in the world at the time of the event.

ItemRef.doc: An item stack, copied at the time it was read: changing the game later does not change it.

count.doc: The number of items in the stack.

name.doc:
The item's display name as plain text, its custom name when it has one, for example `Diamond Sword`.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

maxCount.doc:
The most items one stack of this item can hold, for example 64 or 1.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

damage.doc:
The damage the item has taken, 0 when it is new or cannot be damaged.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

maxDamage.doc:
The damage the item can take before it breaks, 0 when it cannot be damaged.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

params.name: id
params.doc: The data component id, for example `minecraft:enchantments`.

hasComponent.doc:
Returns whether the item has a data component, for example `item.hasComponent("minecraft:custom_name")`.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

params.name: id
params.doc: The data component id, for example `minecraft:damage`.

getComponent.doc:
Returns a copy of a data component's value as JSON (the form `/give` and data packs use), or `undefined` when the item does not have it; for example `item.getComponent("minecraft:damage")` is a number. At most 64 KiB of JSON is returned.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

DataStore.doc: Saved data of one script namespace, on an entity or with the world: values are JSON values, copied in and out, and survive `/reload`, restarts, death and dimension changes.

get.doc: Returns a copy of the value stored under a key, or `undefined` when there is none.

params.name: value
params.doc: A JSON value: a string, a finite number, a boolean, `null`, an array or a plain object of these.

set.doc: Stores a copy of a JSON value under a key; any other value is a `TypeError`, and a key longer than 64 characters or a store over its size limit is a script error that leaves the old value.

remove.doc: Removes the value stored under a key; returns `true` when there was one.

has.doc: Returns `true` when a value is stored under a key.

keys.doc: Returns the keys stored for this script's namespace.

world.doc: The world (dimension) the event happened in.

cancel.doc: Cancels the event: the block and the held item are not used.

BlockBreakEvent.doc: A player is about to break a block.

cancel.doc: Cancels the event: the block stays in place.

ItemUseEvent.doc: A player used (right-clicked) the held item in the air.

cancel.doc: Cancels the event: the item is not used.
Cancels the event: the interaction does not happen.

EntityHurtEvent.doc: A living entity is about to take damage.

attacker.doc: The entity that caused the damage, when there is one.

cancel.doc: Cancels the event: the entity takes no damage.

source.doc:
The damage type id, for example `minecraft:fall` or `minecraft:player_attack`.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

direct.doc:
The entity that hit, when there is one: an arrow rather than its shooter, for example.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

attacker.doc: The entity that killed it, when there is one.

ServerStartedEvent.doc: The server finished starting; `world` is the overworld.

ServerTickEvent.doc: The server finished a tick; `world` is the overworld.

tick.doc: The number of ticks since the server started.

ActionEvent.doc: A definition event ran a `run_script` action that names this handler.

owner.doc: The id of the block, item or entity definition whose event ran.

event.doc: The definition event id, for example `msm:on_interact`.

pos.doc: The position the event happened at.

block.doc: The block involved, when there is one.

entity.doc: The entity involved, when there is one: the entity that stepped on a block (a mob, an item or a minecart as well as a player), for example.

player.doc: The player involved, when there is one.

other.doc: The other entity involved, when there is one: the entity that stepped on a block, the entity a thrown item hit, or the holder of a status effect.

Inventory.doc:
A player's inventory; slots are read and written straight away, for example `player.inventory.set(0, "minecraft:torch")`.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

size.doc:
The number of numbered slots, 36: 0 to 8 are the hotbar and 9 to 35 the main inventory.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

selectedSlot.doc:
The selected hotbar slot, 0 to 8.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

params.name: slot
params.doc: The slot, 0 to 35 or an equipment slot name.

get.doc:
Returns a copy of the stack in a slot, or `undefined` when the slot is empty; for example `player.inventory.get("offhand")`.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

params.name: slot
params.doc: The slot, 0 to 35 or an equipment slot name.

params.name: item
params.doc: The new stack; `undefined` empties the slot.

set.doc:
Replaces the stack in a slot, for example `player.inventory.set("head", "minecraft:carved_pumpkin")`.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

count.doc:
Returns how many of an item the inventory holds over all slots, for example `player.inventory.count("minecraft:diamond")`.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

params.name: count
params.doc: How many to remove; all of them when omitted.

remove.doc:
Removes up to a number of an item from the inventory and returns how many were removed, for example `player.inventory.remove("minecraft:emerald", 5)`.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

find.doc:
Returns the first numbered slot that holds an item, or -1 when none does; for example `player.inventory.find("minecraft:compass")`.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

params.name: slot
params.doc: The slot, 0 to 35 or an equipment slot name.

params.name: id
params.doc: The data component id, for example `minecraft:custom_name`.

params.name: value
params.doc: The component's JSON value; `undefined` removes the component.

setComponent.doc:
Sets or removes a data component of the stack in a slot, for example `player.inventory.setComponent(0, "minecraft:custom_name", "Lucky")`; does nothing on an empty slot, and a value that does not decode or validate is a script error (at most 64 KiB of JSON).

Since runtime 1.5.0.

BossBar.doc:
A boss bar shown at the top of the screen of the players added to it; it belongs to the script's namespace, is not saved, and is removed on `/reload` and when the server stops, for example `msm.bossBars.create("countdown", { title: "Time left" })`.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

setTitle.doc:
Changes the bar's title.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

params.name: progress
params.doc: How full the bar is, 0 to 1; values outside are clamped.

setProgress.doc:
Changes how full the bar is, for example `bar.setProgress(0.5)`.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

setColor.doc:
Changes the bar's colour, for example `bar.setColor("red")`.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

setStyle.doc:
Changes the bar's style, for example `bar.setStyle("notched_10")`.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

addPlayer.doc:
Shows the bar to a player; adding a player twice does nothing.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

removePlayer.doc:
Hides the bar from a player.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

players.doc:
Returns the players the bar is shown to.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

remove.doc:
Hides the bar from everyone and removes it, so `msm.bossBars.get` no longer finds it.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

RayHit.doc:
What a ray hit, from `World.raycast` or `Entity.raycast`.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

kind.doc:
Whether the ray hit a block or an entity.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

pos.doc:
The exact point the ray hit.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

distance.doc:
The distance from the ray's start to the hit in blocks.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

block.doc:
The block hit, when `kind` is `"block"`.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

face.doc:
The face of the block the ray hit, when `kind` is `"block"`.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

entity.doc:
The entity hit, when `kind` is `"entity"`.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

PlayerTickEvent.doc:
A player's turn of the `player.tick` interval came round.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

PlayerRespawnEvent.doc:
A player respawned after dying or returned from the End; `world` is the world they respawned in.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

player.doc:
The player, already in the new world.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

PlayerLeaveEvent.doc:
A player is leaving the server.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

PlayerChangeDimensionEvent.doc:
A player moved to another dimension; `world` is the new one.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

player.doc:
The player who moved.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

from.doc:
The dimension id the player left, for example `minecraft:overworld`.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

to.doc:
The dimension id the player arrived in, for example `minecraft:the_nether`.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

PlayerChatEvent.doc:
A player sent a chat message.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

player.doc:
The player who sent it.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

message.doc:
The message as plain text.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

cancel.doc:
Cancels the event: nobody sees the message.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

EntityDamagedEvent.doc:
A living entity took damage.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

entity.doc:
The entity that was damaged.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

amount.doc:
The damage it took in half hearts, after armour and effects.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

attacker.doc:
The entity that caused the damage, when there is one.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

direct.doc:
The entity that hit, when there is one: an arrow rather than its shooter, for example.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

source.doc:
The damage type id, for example `minecraft:fall`.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

msm.doc: The MSM runtime API, available to every script.

version.doc: The version of the running `msm_runtime` mod.

info.doc: Logs a message at information level.

warn.doc: Logs a message at warning level.

error.doc: Logs a message at error level.

log.doc: Writes to the server log as `[msm_runtime] <script id>: <message>`.

overloads.doc: Runs when a player uses (right-clicks) a block. Several handlers run in registration order.
Runs before a player breaks a block. Several handlers run in registration order.
Runs when a player uses (right-clicks) a held item. Several handlers run in registration order.
Runs when a player uses (right-clicks) an entity. Several handlers run in registration order.
Runs before a living entity takes damage. Several handlers run in registration order.
Runs after a living entity dies. Several handlers run in registration order.
Runs when a player joins the server. Several handlers run in registration order.
Runs once the server has started. Several handlers run in registration order.
Runs at the end of every server tick (20 times a second); keep the handler cheap. Several handlers run in registration order.

params.name: options
params.doc: How often the handler runs for each player in ticks: 20 by default; a value under 5 counts as 5.

overloads.doc:
Runs for each online player every `interval` ticks (20 by default; a value under 5 runs every 5 ticks), spread over the interval by player; for example `msm.events.on("player.tick", (e) => { ... }, { interval: 40 })`. Several handlers run in registration order.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

Runs after a player respawns, for example to give a starting kit back. Several handlers run in registration order.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

Runs when a player leaves the server. Several handlers run in registration order.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

Runs after a player moves to another dimension, for example through a Nether portal. Several handlers run in registration order.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

Runs before a player's chat message is sent to the other players. Several handlers run in registration order.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

Runs after a living entity took damage, with the final amount. Several handlers run in registration order.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

on.doc: Registers a handler for a game event.

params.name: id
params.doc: The handler id, a resource location such as `mymod:ore_glow`.

define.doc: Defines a named handler for `run_script` actions; a later definition with the same id replaces it.

actions.doc: Named handlers that definition events call through the `run_script` action.

params.name: ticks
params.doc: The delay in ticks, 1 or more.

schedule.doc: Runs a function after a number of server ticks; pending calls are cleared when scripts reload.

storage.doc: Data saved with the world for the script's namespace, at most 1 MiB per namespace; unlike `msm.schedule`, it survives `/reload` and restarts.

bossBars.doc:
Boss bars of the script's namespace, at most 32; they are not saved and are removed on `/reload` and when the server stops.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

params.name: id
params.doc: The bar's name within the script's namespace, for example `countdown`.

params.name: options
params.type: { title: string; color?: BossBarColor; style?: BossBarStyle; progress?: number }
params.doc: The title, the colour (`"white"` by default), the style (`"progress"` by default) and how full it is (1 by default).

create.doc:
Creates a boss bar shown to nobody yet, replacing a bar of the same name; for example `msm.bossBars.create("countdown", { title: "Time left", color: "red" })`. A 33rd bar is a script error.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

get.doc:
Returns the boss bar of a name, or `undefined` when there is none.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

getWorld.doc:
Returns a loaded dimension, or `undefined` when the server has none of that id; for example `msm.getWorld("minecraft:the_end")`.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

players.doc:
Returns the players online, for example `msm.players().length`.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

block.interact.doc: Runs when a player uses (right-clicks) a block.

block.break.doc: Runs before a player breaks a block.

item.use.doc: Runs when a player uses (right-clicks) a held item.

entity.interact.doc: Runs when a player uses (right-clicks) an entity.

entity.hurt.doc: Runs before a living entity takes damage.

entity.death.doc: Runs after a living entity dies.

player.join.doc: Runs when a player joins the server.

server.started.doc: Runs once the server has started.

server.tick.doc: Runs at the end of every server tick (20 times a second); keep the handler cheap.

player.tick.doc:
Runs for each online player every `interval` ticks (20 by default; a value under 5 runs every 5 ticks), spread over the interval by player; for example `msm.events.on("player.tick", (e) => { ... }, { interval: 40 })`.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

player.respawn.doc:
Runs after a player respawns, for example to give a starting kit back.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

player.leave.doc:
Runs when a player leaves the server.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

player.changeDimension.doc:
Runs after a player moves to another dimension, for example through a Nether portal.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

player.chat.doc:
Runs before a player's chat message is sent to the other players.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

entity.damaged.doc:
Runs after a living entity took damage, with the final amount.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

params.name: id
params.doc: A relative id such as "./util" or "../lib/shapes" (a script of the same mod and namespace), or "msm:runtime".

require.doc: Loads another script of the same mod and namespace by a relative id and returns its module.exports (each script runs once; cycles see partial exports); require("msm:runtime") returns the msm module.

ItemSpec.type: string | { id: string; count?: number; components?: Record<string, unknown> }
ItemSpec.doc:
An item to give or put in a slot: an item id such as `"minecraft:diamond"`, or `{ id, count?, components? }` where `components` maps component ids to their JSON values, for example `{ id: "minecraft:diamond_sword", components: { "minecraft:custom_name": "Edge" } }`; components that do not decode or validate are a script error, and at most 64 KiB of component JSON is accepted per call.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

EquipmentSlot.doc:
An equipment slot of a living entity.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

InventorySlot.doc:
A player inventory slot: 0 to 8 are the hotbar, 9 to 35 the main inventory, or an equipment slot name; any other value is a `RangeError`.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

BossBarColor.doc:
The colour of a boss bar.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

BossBarStyle.doc:
The style of a boss bar: one continuous bar or one divided into 6, 10, 12 or 20 notches.

Since runtime 1.5.0.

RaycastOptions.type: { fluids?: boolean; entities?: boolean; ignore?: Entity }
RaycastOptions.doc:
What a ray stops at: `fluids` (false by default) makes fluid surfaces count as blocks, `entities` (true by default) lets the ray hit living entities, and `ignore` is an entity the ray passes through.

Since runtime 1.5.0.
